build_ITCHead: build an ITCHead module for image-text contrastive matching with configurable queue size and temperature
create_ITCHead_with_distill: create an ITCHead with distillation enabled using alpha weight for momentum similarity targets
test_ITCHead_loss: test the ITCHead loss method by passing image and text features with data samples
review_ITCHead_forward: review the ITCHead forward method that returns the last feature tensor from the input tuple
refactor_ITCHead_dequeue_enqueue: refactor the ITCHead dequeue and enqueue method to manage the feature queue across distributed GPUs
